title: Enforcing Code Reasoning in Agentic Scaffold for More Effective Issue Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.23782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning is central to ReAct-based programming agents, yet whether and how they reason about code remains unclear. We study 7,955 issue-resolution trajectories from six single- and multi-agent scaffolds across four programming languages on SWE-bench-Verified, SWE-bench-Pro, and SWE-bench-Lite. We identify 12 forms of code reasoning in 66.95% of trajectories. Code reasoning is associated with higher resolution rates, and its intensity increases with task complexity. However, it remains largely unguided: agents may focus on surface-level symptoms during localization, fail to refine near-correct patches, overlook issue requirements, and generate tests with limited behavioral diversity. To address these limitations, we propose DeskCheck, an agentic scaffold that systematically guides code reasoning throughout repository-level issue resolution. DeskCheck simulates execution paths to localize root causes, simulates candidate patches to refine

translated_title: 在智能体脚手架中强化代码推理以实现更高效的议题解决
translated_abstract: 推理是基于ReAct的编程智能体的核心，然而这些智能体是否以及如何对代码进行推理仍不清楚。我们在SWE-bench-Verified、SWE-bench-Pro和SWE-bench-Lite上，研究了来自六种单智能体与多智能体脚手架、涵盖四种编程语言的7,955条议题解决轨迹。我们在66.95%的轨迹中识别出12种代码推理形式。代码推理与更高的解决率相关，且其强度随任务复杂度增加而上升。然而，代码推理在很大程度上缺乏引导：智能体在定位问题时可能只关注表层症状，无法完善接近正确的补丁，忽略议题需求，并生成行为多样性有限的测试。为解决这些局限，我们提出了DeskCheck，一个在仓库级议题解决全过程中系统性引导代码推理的智能体脚手架。DeskCheck通过模拟执行路径来定位根本原因，通过模拟候选补丁来完善……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过分析7,955条智能体编程轨迹揭示代码推理的形式及其缺乏引导的问题，并提出了DeskCheck智能体脚手架，通过模拟执行路径定位根因、模拟候选补丁等方式系统性引导代码推理，从而提升仓库级议题解决的效果。
en_tdlr: The study analyzes 7,955 agent trajectories to characterize code reasoning and its lack of guidance, and proposes DeskCheck, an agentic scaffold that systematically enforces code reasoning by simulating execution paths and candidate patches for more effective repository-level issue resolution.
